correctness.rationale: For each r-subset S, the chance all points remain unseen after t independent draws is a_S^t; summing gives the exact factorial-moment identity. Fixed block size makes mean a_S equal to the hypergeometric full-model avoidance probability, so strict Jensen proves the inequality and its equality case. Counting r-supersets of a j-set within a random complement, followed by inclusion-exclusion, rigorously proves equality iff weighted design strength r whenever r<=min(k,v-k). Projective-plane pair/triple incidence gives a two-valued rank-three avoidance profile, exact collinearity frequency, and the positive all-order formula, including the two-round rational expression. The standalone independent finite enumeration/checker passed 702 exact rational consistency tests for small instances. These tests do not replace the displayed all-order proof.

value.rationale: Recent work shows expected completion time cannot be universally ordered among fair group-draw mechanisms. The exact fixed-time moment hierarchy identifies a different mathematically natural and measurable structural boundary: equality through rank r is equivalent to weighted r-design strength. In projective-plane coupon sampling, all first- and second-order unseen-count statistics exactly conceal the geometric mechanism at every time, yet the third factorial moment yields an explicit nonzero rational discrepancy for every existing plane order. This provides a structurally motivated diagnostic, including all prime-power orders, without asserting completion-time implications.
